title: Petition of Boston Duck Tours requesting that the Department of Public Utilities issue a license for the operation of motor vehicles in sightseeing service in and from the City of Boston, and over public ways under the jurisdiction of the Metropolitan District Commission, pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, Appendix, and G.L. c. 159, § 7, and that the Department issue it a charter license from a garaging point in Boston, pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 11A.
